entries.title: ExpVoyager: Direct Experience Navigation for Dynamic Agent Skill Synthesis
entries.summary: ExpVoyager reframes agent skill synthesis as on-demand navigation over raw past trajectories rather than prematurely compressing experience into fixed skills. A skill curator explores multiple views and resolutions of experience, extracts reusable procedural knowledge for the current task, and tracks unresolved knowledge needs to guide further retrieval, producing continual gains as experience accumulates.

entries.title: DexAgent: An Agentic Human2Sim2Robot Framework for Dexterous Manipulation with Self-Evolving Tool Library
entries.summary: DexAgent turns human videos into robot-training trajectories through a verification-guided agent pipeline that can select existing skills or create new ones when task and object properties demand them. Newly developed skills and verifiers persist in its tool library, so the system accumulates reusable capabilities and becomes more efficient as it processes additional tasks.

entries.title: Harness Learning Enables Generalizable Test-Time Adaptation
entries.summary: Harness learning trains a proposer with reinforcement learning to revise a language-model agent's executable harness from execution feedback. At test time the proposer repeatedly improves the solver's control program on unseen tasks without changing model weights, turning harness edits into a meta-learned analogue of gradient updates and enabling iterative, transferable agent improvement.

entries.title: Improving Test-Time Scaling with Adaptive Looped Transformers
entries.summary: TaH2 post-trains a looped Transformer with a token-level iteration decider trained from online lookahead labels that indicate whether another recurrent step improves prediction. This makes latent test-time compute selective rather than fixed-depth, improving the accuracy-compute scaling slope and continuing to benefit from deeper recurrence where earlier looped models plateau.

entries.title: Not All Thinking is Created Equal: Latent Reasoning Discovers a Recurrent Search Algorithm for Depth Generalization
entries.summary: Using matched GPTNeoX variants, this work finds that latent recurrent reasoning learns an internal forward-reachability algorithm that generalizes to deeper multi-hop problems better than vanilla, chain-of-thought, or pause-token computation. Circuit interventions localize the reusable search process to attention, MLP, residual-state updates, and repeated latent steps.

entries.title: Scheduling Recursive Reasoning in Looped Transformers
entries.summary: TAPS treats recurrent update scale as a control axis alongside loop count. It decomposes progress along a recurrent trajectory into persistent and fluctuating components, then adapts step size online; the resulting scheduler improves terminal accuracy without retraining and, when incorporated into training, reaches matched accuracy with up to 1.56x wall-clock speedup.

entries.title: Estimating and Orthogonalizing Unknown Pre-training Gradients for Continual Fine-tuning of Large Language Models
entries.summary: EoupCT protects an LLM's broad pretrained capabilities during sequential fine-tuning even when the original pretraining data and gradients are unavailable. A learnable soft prompt generates pseudo-data that exposes vulnerable knowledge, estimates corresponding pretraining gradients, and a Pareto optimizer keeps new-task updates orthogonal to those estimated directions.

entries.title: SAMBAR: Selective Anchoring via Method of Multipliers for Balanced Knowledge Acquisition and Retention in Vision-Language-Action Models
entries.summary: SAMBAR casts replay-free continual adaptation of pretrained vision-language-action models as constrained optimization. It selectively anchors parameters important to prior tasks and uses a dual variable to increase pressure when accumulated drift violates the retention constraint, preserving earlier robot skills while leaving capacity for new ones.

entries.title: When the Merge Coefficient Stops Mattering: Proximity Regularized Merging for Continual LoRA Adaptation
entries.summary: PRM modifies continual LoRA write-in by training each new low-rank task vector with a proximal penalty before merging it into the running model. The smaller, more mergeable updates reduce Fisher-weighted interference and broaden the range of safe merge coefficients, offering a simple rehearsal-free stability-plasticity mechanism for sequential adapter learning.

entries.title: BIRD: Distilling Decision Boundaries into Rationales for MLLM Adaptation
entries.summary: BIRD makes multimodal LLM adaptation self-improving by using the target model's own confusions to identify unresolved decision boundaries, generating candidate visual evidence, functionally testing which evidence actually changes the correct preference, and distilling verified evidence into rationales for fine-tuning. The supervision is therefore tailored to weaknesses discovered by the model itself.

entries.title: Position Aware Layer Queries for Test Time Training in Vision Language Models
entries.summary: Layer Query Network makes test-time training of frozen vision-language Transformers cheaper by extracting supervision from intermediate spatial tokens in a single teacher forward pass. Position-aware distillation and coordinate-based consistency train a lightweight student online, improving zero-shot robustness under distribution shift without repeatedly backpropagating through the full VLM.

entries.title: Learning Native Reflection in Unified Models with Interleaved Reinforcement Learning
entries.summary: UMM-Reflection trains one unified multimodal model to inspect its own generated image, diagnose defects, revise the image, and repeat. Interleaved reinforcement learning assigns one trajectory-level advantage to both reflection tokens and flow-based revisions across multiple rounds, producing a model that can execute learned self-repair loops at inference without an external critic.
